label: Whatever causes a quality in another thing is MORE_3 more such than it, by measured degree
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred: the ordinary-comparative (MORE_3) reading of 'more such' d5a94eb1. Every c, distinct from x, that causes x's being r (CAUSE_2) is more r than x on the ordinary comparative: both have r formally and c's measured degree of r (a supplied measure deg) is strictly higher, as the cause of another's heat is hotter. It is the reading on which d5a94eb1's paraphrase gives its example; whether Posterior Analytics I.2 means it is not claimed. The eminent reading (MORE_4) is a different statement. Open.
